observation_contract.measurements: Object keyed by exact measurement_path. Values contain value, method, evidence path, execution=observed|not_executed. OCR is native_pixels. Missing offscreen evidence is not_assessed. A source declaration cannot pass an executed action assertion.
observation_contract.not_assessed: No sufficient artifact for this check (e.g. lower rows outside captured viewport with no scroll capture); neither pass nor fail.
observation_contract.unscorable: Evidence exists but cannot establish a valid measurement or uses an incompatible method.

action_trace_contract.execution: Actual native activations and host callback trace only. If unavailable, source review may flag defects but execution remains not_executed.
action_trace_contract.controlled_state: Log callbacks without changing inputs; capture unchanged UI, then perform explicit caller_update.
action_trace_contract.inert_taps: Tap native informational text/row area outside buttons; expected zero callback delta.

do_not_penalize: content below viewport when parent scroll can expose it
mandatory_review: RTL arrangement and fractional fill direction

stages: read-only self-review on public/self-chosen examples; no D0 edit
aggregation: Separate build/render blocking defects, per-rule conformance, blinded visual quality, and evidence coverage. A rule passes only if all applicable required checks were observed and passed. Missing evidence never passes. Any actual applicable failure fails the rule. No component clipping failure solely because parent-scroll content is below the viewport.

platform_method_policy.capability_report_origin: Harness operator, reported before freeze; not an independently executed designer result.

compose_android.native_semantics: Full real unmerged nodes, bounds and TextLayoutResult available. Actual native OnClick and recorded callback traces can be executed.
compose_android.callback_pass: Requires an actual native activation plus callback trace.

swiftui_ios.native_pixels: Real native PNG plus Apple Vision OCR available.
swiftui_ios.native_semantics: Unavailable in common UIHostingController unit-test host: known identifier-bearing Button probe also exports zero AX elements.
swiftui_ios.a11y_contract: Use source_review for public identifiers, labels, progress declarations and roles; do not claim a native-semantic pass. Empty AX export alone is infrastructure evidence limitation, never a component failure.
swiftui_ios.runtime_a11y: not_assessed without another actual native evidence path.
swiftui_ios.runtime_action: not_executed without actual UI events. Source review may identify a defect but cannot pass callback execution.
swiftui_ios.native_fraction: not_assessed when native numerical evidence unavailable; visible percentage and track rendering may still be assessed by native_pixels/OCR.
